learning_outcomes.text: Understand the Java language: structure of a program, declaration of function and procedures.
Understand standard procedures, functions and data types.
Understand abstract data types: table, stack, LIFO, list, tree.
Understand abstract operations: search, sort, interpolation, iteration, recursion, backtracking.
Understand single and double linked lists, trees.
Understand the basics of object oriented programming.
Apply Java in a graphics environment - forms, windows.

syllabus_topics: Basic syntax, (simple or primitive) variables, commands, output of result.
Arrays, strings, build-in-functions, input from console, the for cycle. Debugging.
Classes, instances of classes (objects). Static and dynamic variables. Constructor.
Procedures and functions. Interpolation, iteration, recursion. Cycles, input from file.
Abstract data types in arrays: table, stack, (circular) queue.
Dynamic structure principle nodes, pointers, linked lists.
Sorting algorithms theory. Bubble. Biggest value. Other O(n\u00b2).
Sorting algorithms Quicksort. Median. Heapsort, Mergesort. Bucket sort. Stable and in-place categories of algorithms.
OOP principles inheritance, encapsulation. Events. Exceptions and messages. Error handling.
Graphical environment, create an application with windows and forms.
Java animation. Drawing graphs in Java.
bibliography: D. S. Malik,Robert P. Burton: Java Programming: Guided Learning With Early Objects. Course Technology, 2009.
Wirth, N.: Algorithms and data structures. Prentice-Hall, 1986.
Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, Stein: Introduction to Algorithms.
